word.definition: The adjective Pyrrhic describes something that is achieved at an excessive cost.

sports_fact.text: Jim Thorpe was stripped of his 1912 Olympic gold medals because he had been paid $25 a week to play minor league baseball — they were restored in 1983, 30 years after his death.

market.headline: Investors Are Betting a Blue Wave Will Help Hospitals. Don’t Count on It.
market.summary: Markets are anticipating a reversal of Trump’s Medicaid cuts. That may be easier said than done.

quote.text: You let yourselves be deprived before your own eyes of the best part of your revenues; your fields are plundered, your homes robbed, your family heirlooms taken away. You live in such a way that you cannot claim a single thing as your own; and it would seem that you consider yourselves lucky to be loaned your property, your families, and your very lives.
quote.author: Étienne de La Boétie

history.text: World War II: Matanikau Offensive begins during the Guadalcanal campaign and ends three days later with an American victory.
